title: Toxic effect of silica nanoparticles on endothelial cells through DNA damage response via Chk1-dependent G2/M checkpoint

grounded.context: HUVECs exposed to silica nanoparticles for 24 h, review of results
grounded.evidence_quote: Silica nanoparticles-induced ROS generation caused oxidative damage followed by the production of MDA as well as the inhibition of SOD and GSH-Px.
grounded.location: CAPTION: Oxidative stress and oxidative damage induced by silica nanoparticles on HUVECs.
